name: DataTable
need: A styled, accessible table. Today the guidance is 'drop a semantic <table> inside <Card flush> and style it inline' — which every dashboard re-implements differently (the AI/Run rubric matrix, portfolio table, etc.). A canonical Table standardizes header/row/cell styling, tokened borders, tabular-nums, sticky header, and an optional highlighted column.

consideredAlternatives.whyNot: Not a component: no shared header/cell/border/zebra styling; re-hand-rolled per page.
Lists are single-column rows, not multi-column tabular data with a header.

proposedApi.compositional: Table, THead, TBody, Tr, Th, Td
